findings.claim: 蘋果絕大多數製造由位於中國大陸、印度、日本、南韓、台灣、越南的外包夥伴完成；10-K 風險因素指出貿易限制（關稅與進出口管制）可能對業務與供應鏈造成重大不利影響。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: A significant majority of the Company’s manufacturing is performed in whole or in part by outsourcing partners located primarily in China mainland, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam, in addition to sourcing from partners and facilities located in the U.S.

findings.claim: 商務部 232 條款半導體及衍生產品調查初步結果於 2026-01-14 公布，未對蘋果產品加徵額外關稅。
findings.excerpt: On January 14, 2026, initial results were published of the previously announced U.S. Department of Commerce investigation under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962, as amended, into imports of semiconductors

findings.claim: 最高法院 2026-02-20 判決推翻部分 IEEPA 關稅，蘋果已申請退稅並將收到的退稅列為產品銷貨成本減項。
findings.excerpt: Separately, on February 20, 2026, the Supreme Court issued a ruling striking down certain tariffs previously imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act of 1977. The Company has applied for a refund of tariffs paid

findings.claim: FY2026 產品毛利率較 FY2025 上升，主因包含產品組合與關稅退款，部分被含記憶體在內的成本上升抵銷（產品毛利率 39.3% 對 36.8%）。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 7 MD&A Gross Margin
findings.excerpt: Products gross margin and gross margin percentage increased during 2026 compared to 2025 primarily due to product mix and tariff refunds, partially offset by higher costs, including memory.
